Gang Determination.description: 当一名切利亚斯忠诚派与至少一名盟友相邻时，其意志豁免检定获得+1环境加值。

For Cheliax!.name: 为了切利亚斯！ For Cheliax!
For Cheliax!.description: 切利亚斯忠诚派首领行走，同时高喊向切利亚斯效忠的口号。若其在移动结束时与一名敌人相邻，则对该敌人进行一次钉头锤打击。每名听见并看见忠诚派首领发起攻击的盟友都可以使用其反应动作向该敌人行走。

Viro Ahala.name: 维罗·阿哈拉 Viro Ahala
Viro Ahala.blurb: 男性人类地狱骑士扈从

+3 to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects.name: +3 to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects

Punishing Cut.name: Punishing Cut
Punishing Cut.description: Viro makes a longsword Strike. This counts as two attacks for his multiple attack penalty. If the Strike hits, it deals an additional die of weapon damage and 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

Shielded Charge.name: Shielded Charge
Shielded Charge.description:
Requirements Viro is wielding a shield

Effect Viro Raises his Shield and then Strides twice. If he ends his movement adjacent to a foe, that foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to Viro's Strikes until the end of Viro's current turn.

Creatures of the Night.name: 夜行生物 Creatures of the Night
Creatures of the Night.disable: @Check[nature|dc:24]或@Check[religion|dc:24]（受训）以驱散害兽；需要2次成功才能解除它。
Creatures of the Night.hazarddescription: 蝙蝠与老鼠在埃齐奥的敌人周围翻涌。
Creatures of the Night.routine: （1动作）蝙蝠与老鼠啃咬房间内所有生物，造成@Damage[(2d8+3)[piercing]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]豁免）。失败时，该生物还会受到@Damage[3[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

Infest.name: 侵扰 Infest
Infest.description:
触发 埃齐奥召唤出集群

效果 集群以令人作呕的方式聚合。房间内的每个生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}（大失败则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}）。随后该危害骰先攻。

Prison Break.name: 越狱 Prison Break
Prison Break.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:27]以阻止囚犯前进；@Check[diplomacy|dc:30]来与这群囚犯讲道理；或@Check[intimidation|dc:27]以震慑他们冷静下来。
Prison Break.hazarddescription: 一群囚犯暴起冲向自由，践踏沿途的一切。
Prison Break.routine:
（1动作）囚犯们朝出口方向踩踏而过，对K9区域及其北侧走廊内的每个活物造成@Damage[(2d10+9)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。若豁免大失败，该生物对其携带的任何物品的抓握力度减弱，与危害对其成功@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{卸武}相同。若抓握本就已经被减弱，则物品掉落。

特殊 若PC们在4轮后仍未击败该危害，则危害自动结束，因为所有囚犯都已逃脱。

Rush to Freedom.name: 冲向自由 Rush to Freedom
Rush to Freedom.description:
触发 拘押牢房B的门被打开

效果 危害抓取距离门口20尺内任意生物的武器，以+19调整值尝试对其进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{卸武}，然后骰先攻。

Vampire Vulnerabilities.name: 吸血鬼易伤 Vampire Vulnerabilities
Vampire Vulnerabilities.description:
All vampires possess the following vulnerabilities.

  • Compulsions Vampires are creatures with strange and unknowable compulsions. A typical vampire can't voluntarily cross running water unless they're transported while they hide within their coffin, nor can they enter a private dwelling unless invited in by someone with the authority to do so. At your discretion, vampires might have different compulsions—a pirate vampire might not be able to set foot on solid ground without being invited, for example. The vampire can still be forced to do these things and might be able to overcome their compulsion just as they do their revulsion.
  • Revulsion A vampire can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so, and it remains brandished for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the vampire involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, a vampire can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Stake A wooden stake driven through a vampire's heart drops the vampire to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a vampire requires 3 actions and works only if the vampire is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If the stake is removed, the vampire can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the vampire's head is severed and anointed with holy water while the stake is in place, the vampire is destroyed.
  • Sunlight If exposed to direct sunlight, a vampire immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. The slowed value increases by 1 each time the vampire ends their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If the vampire loses all their actions in this way, they're destroyed. Due to their supernatural aversion to light, vampires don't cast shadows or show a reflection in mirrors

Dominate.name: 支配 Dominate
Dominate.description:
The vampire can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait (@Check[will|dc:22]). A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to that vampire's Dominate for 24 hours.

Fully destroying the vampire ends the domination, but merely reducing the vampire to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

Drink Blood.name: 吸血 Drink Blood
Drink Blood.description:
Requirement A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the vampire's reach.

Effect The vampire sinks its fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions.

The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the vampire regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the vampire but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. A vampire can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but it gains no HP from doing so.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Blood Transfusion] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

Spellstrike.name: 法术打击 Spellstrike
Spellstrike.description:
频率 直到被再充能

效果 海德温六世将一个法术注入他的爪打击中，以进行一次混合攻击。他施放一个需要进行法术攻击骰的法术。该法术的效果不会立刻发生，而是注入他的攻击之中。他尝试一次爪近战打击，且该次攻击骰同时决定打击与法术两者的效果。在计算多重攻击减值时，这一动作被计算为两次攻击，但是他不会应用这一减值直到其完成法术打击后为止。灌注而入的法术能量使他的打击获得奥法特征，使其魔法化。使用法术打击后，他在以一个单动作为其法术打击再充能前不能再次使用；该再充能动作具有专注特征。当他吸血时，也会为其法术打击再充能。

Zombie Giant Bat.name: 丧尸巨蝙蝠 Zombie Giant Bat
Zombie Giant Bat.publicNotes:
While big bats are certainly not uncommon in dark caves and abandoned ruins and may instill fear in squeamish spelunkers, the so-called giant bat is a true monster, weighing well over 100 pounds and having a wingspan of nearly 15 feet. It primarily eats fruit and bugs, but can be incited to violence through fear or hunger. Giant bat attacks can quickly give rise to rumors of more dangerous monsters—many mistake these massive animals for some sort of demon or vampiric monster. But like other bats, giant bats are simply social and intelligent mammals. They are sometimes used as mounts by smaller humanoids, commonly those who hail from or dwell in mountainous or underground regions.

A wide range of bats dwell throughout the world. Most of these nocturnal animals are harmless insectivores, but deadly breeds of vampire bats and oversized bats the size of horses pose much more significant threats to adventurers.

Slow.name: 缓慢 Slow
Slow.description: 丧尸具有永久性的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1}且无法使用反应动作。

Clumsy Flier.name: 笨拙飞行者 Clumsy Flier
Clumsy Flier.description: 虽然丧尸巨蝙蝠能够飞行，但其翅膀几乎无法将其托起。若其在空中时受到重击或任意数量的挥砍伤害，它会坠落，且在下一回合不能飞行。

Rotting Aura.name: 腐烂灵光 Rotting Aura
Rotting Aura.description: 10尺。丧尸巨蝙蝠散发出腐烂与疾病的灵光，这一灵光使得伤口溃烂。任何活物若在灵光范围内开始其回合，且未处于满生命值，则受到@Damage[1d6[void]]伤害。

Practice Guard's Grasp.name: 练习卫兵之握 Practice Guard's Grasp
Practice Guard's Grasp.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18]（受训）以卡住网，或@Check[athletics|dc:25]以推倒假人。
Practice Guard's Grasp.hazarddescription: 弹簧驱动的绳网从假人中弹射，随后通过磁力收紧。

Got You!.name: 逮到你了！ Got You!
Got You!.description:
触发 有生物移动至与陷阱相邻

效果 该生物必须尝试一次@Check[reflex|dc:23]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}（若大失败则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}）。可以[[/act escape dc=23]]，或对网造成6点酸蚀、火焰或挥砍伤害以将其割开。

Adiutor.name: 魔化助手 Adiutor
Adiutor.publicNotes:
魔化助手虽然绰号被称为后备魔鬼，但他们并非真正的魔鬼，只是被灌注了地狱力量的凡人。这些凡人因对暴政与压迫事业的忠诚而获得奖赏，从而尝到了地狱的威能。渴求力量的魔化助手会冷酷且不择手段地强制贯彻地狱的意志，以期能实现他们那已经入魔的野心。由于切利亚斯与地狱势力的关联，因此魔化助手在切利亚斯及其管辖的领土上最为常见，为斯戎家族热衷于干涉凡人事务的强大魔鬼充当间谍和线人。

尽管部分魔化助手能沿着凡人社会的阶梯向上攀爬，成为地狱骑士或其他暴政的支持者，但大多数魔化助手都拥有更强的野心，渴望自己能够化身魔鬼。为了达到这一点，他们会寻求并侍奉更强大的魔鬼，并达成有利于自身的交易，以确保能够让自己完成转化。魔化助手最鄙视的事物莫过于自己的凡人本质——当魔鬼这样的存在行走于物质宇宙之间时，以他们那完美的地狱的视角来说，凡人本质就是软弱的象征。

魔化助手虽然最常出现在与地狱具有联系的地点或人物附近，但他们实际上可以现身于任何地点，悄悄地密谋权力与地位，以便成为他们梦寐以求的地狱官僚。

Avernian Armskote.name: 地狱武库 Avernian Armskote
Avernian Armskote.description: 魔化助手通过以魔法召唤由阿弗纳斯的愚人城塞制造的地狱火弹药来进行装填。他以燧发滑膛枪作出的打击具有魔法并且能造成额外2d6点火焰伤害。

Fiendish Reload.name: 魔盾装填 Fiendish Reload
Fiendish Reload.description: 当魔化助手装填燧发滑膛枪时，他能以相同动作的一部分来施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]。

Punish the Wayward.name: 惩罚刺头 Punish the Wayward
Punish the Wayward.description:
魔化助手作出1次近战或远程打击。若此次打击成功，目标生物承受正常伤害并且必须额外尝试@Check[will|dc:22]豁免。

大成功 该生物不会受到额外影响。

成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 该生物陷入惊惧1。只要他还能看到魔化助手，就无法降低其惊惧状态。

大失败 同失败，但是该生物在陷入惊惧之时，还会对魔化助手来说陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

Instillo.name: 灌输魔 Instillo
Instillo.publicNotes: 在九层地狱那燃烧的阴影之下，凡是需要教化与训导的地方——迪斯的事务机构和厄瑞波斯的金库，到玛尔博吉的战争学院以及凯恩纳的法庭——教导魔鬼都孜孜不倦地从事着她们那谦逊且敏锐的行当。这些魔鬼所具备的天赋及创造力皆用于向被俘获的听众灌输对地狱之道及其正统性的尊崇，她们因此而得名灌输魔，其能力由于能将新征服的土地转化为顺从、甚至忠诚的附庸国而备受重视。她们教导被征服者为自己的出身而感到羞耻；向绝望之人宣告新的人生哲学，即它们所承受的指责与不安皆因为错误的历史与地理；教育孤儿们要尊敬那些将他们变为孤儿的人。
Instillo.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Correcting Veil.name: 矫正帷幕 Correcting Veil
Correcting Veil.description: 100尺。灌输魔的心灵感应场域持续监控着周遭的思维方式，并将其思想向着地狱的思维模式进行塑造。灵光内的生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]技能专长但对此效果浑然不觉。当灵光内有任何生物在回忆知识检定中失败时，灌输魔会立即意识到它的失败，并且会影响该生物获取到的错误信息。

Nod of the Tongue.name: 点舌应允 Nod of the Tongue
Nod of the Tongue.description: 若生物能理解魔鬼语，那么该生物就会在对抗灌输魔的具有听觉或心灵特征的效果时，意志豁免承受-2点状态减值。

Quiet Confidence.name: 镇静自若 Quiet Confidence
Quiet Confidence.description: 灌输魔能隐藏其魔法的来源。若灌输魔的下个动作是施放法术，该法术会获得晦匿特征。该特征仅能隐藏法术的施法动作和表现，无法隐藏其效果。

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description: 灌输魔的打击对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]的生物造成额外2d6点精准伤害。

Superlative Rhetoric.name: 高阶修辞法 Superlative Rhetoric
Superlative Rhetoric.description:
频率 1次/轮

需求 灌输魔最近的动作是施放具有听觉特征的法术

效果 灌输魔立即对一名能够听到她的生物施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]。

Lights Out.name: 熄灯 Lights Out
Lights Out.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:18]（受训）以驱散黑暗，或@Check[deception|dc:19]或@Check[performance|dc:19]（受训）以假装睡着；解除该作祟总计需要2次成功。
Lights Out.hazarddescription: 一片片黑暗笼罩着房间里破旧的床铺，黑暗中传来孩子轻柔的鼾声。
Lights Out.routine: （1动作；黑暗、异能）作祟随机选择1名活物，且该活物在上一轮没有被黑暗吞没。超自然黑暗在该生物身上涌现，其必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:18]豁免。失败时，该生物被以其为中心的@Template[type:emanation|distance:5]弥漫范围的黑暗吞没，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，持续1轮。弥漫范围内的任何生物必须尝试一次自己的意志豁免，否则同样会陷入目盲。目标生物手持或穿戴的任何非魔法光源，以及1环或更低环级的魔法光源会在该持续时间内停止发光。
Lights Out.reset: 所有活物离开房间1分钟后，此作祟会停止活动，但之后会立即重置。若被解除，作祟会在1天后重置。若此处的阁楼低语者被摧毁，此作祟将被永久摧毁。

Lullaby and Good Night.name: 摇篮曲与晚安 Lullaby and Good Night
Lullaby and Good Night.description:
触发 至少两名活物进入房间

效果 空气中充满舒缓的摇篮曲声。房间内的所有活物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:22]豁免。随后该作祟骰先攻。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物感到稍微有些困倦，在察觉检定受到-1状态减值，持续1轮。

失败 该生物短暂地打起盹来。其陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1}，且无法使用反应动作，持续1轮。

大失败 与失败相同，但@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 2}。

Isgeri Slayer.name: 依斯嘉猎杀者 Isgeri Slayer

Hunt Prey.name: 猎杀目标 Hunt Prey
Hunt Prey.description:
依斯嘉猎杀者将其能看见并听见的一个生物，或其正在追踪的一个生物，指定为目标。

猎杀者在[[/act seek]]该猎物的察觉检定与[[/act track]]该猎物的生存检定上获得+2环境加值。

每轮中猎杀者第一次命中该指定目标时，会额外造成1d8精准伤害。猎杀者还会无视在其第二射程增量内进行远程攻击时的减值。上述效果持续至猎杀者再次使用猎杀目标为止。

Twin Takedown.name: 双重攻击 Twin Takedown
Twin Takedown.description:
需求 依斯嘉猎杀者正持用2把近战武器，每把武器分别持握在不同的手中

效果 依斯嘉猎杀者用手中的每把武器快速攻击猎杀目标，有可能将两者造成的创伤结合起来达成单次毁灭性的打击。其对猎杀目标作出2次打击，每次打击分别使用需求的武器。若2次都命中相同的猎杀目标，则判断抗力及弱点时将两者的伤害合计之后再行判断。依斯嘉猎杀者如常为每次打击应用他们的多重攻击减值。

Varlario Demicci.name: 瓦拉里奥·德米奇 Varlario Demicci
Varlario Demicci.blurb: 默语魔道的无性别特工

Shadow Blending.name: 融身于影 Shadow Blending
Shadow Blending.description:
频率 每分钟一次

触发 当瓦拉里奥因昏暗光照或黑暗而处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态时，有生物尝试进行纯骰检定以将其作为目标

效果 阴影缠绕瓦拉里奥的身体。该纯骰检定的DC提高2。

Hidden Familiar.name: 隐藏魔宠 Hidden Familiar
Hidden Familiar.description: 瓦拉里奥通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.F1nlmqOIucch3Cmt]{宠伴存储}法术@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}了自己的蝙蝠魔宠。除非使用撕裂灵魂，否则祂会一直把蝙蝠藏起来。

Shred Spirit.name: 撕裂灵魂 Shred Spirit
Shred Spirit.description:
频率 每分钟一次

效果 瓦拉里奥放出其蝙蝠魔宠，使其作为魅影的通道去撕扯30尺内某个生物的灵魂。目标生物必须成功通过@Check[will|dc:26|basic]豁免，否则受到@Damage[9d6[spirit]]伤害。随后瓦拉里奥恢复等于所造成伤害一半的生命值。

Sister of the Golden Erinys.name: 金怒魔姐妹会修女 Sister of the Golden Erinys

Claw of Pain.name: 痛苦之爪 Claw of Pain
Claw of Pain.description: 当这名修女使用疾风连击的两次打击以同一个生物为目标时，她能令目标承受挥之不去的痛苦。若其中任意一次打击命中并造成伤害，则目标必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:18]豁免，否则受到@Damage[1d4[persistent,mental]]伤害（若为大失败，则同时陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}）。

Flurry of Blows.name: 疾风连击 Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description: 修女进行两次拳头打击，如常应用她的多重攻击减值。若两次打击都命中同一个生物，则在计算抗力和弱点时，将两次打击的伤害合并计算。

Spreading Fire.name: 蔓延的火势 Spreading Fire
Spreading Fire.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:17]检定以将装满橡树胆墨水的桶泼向火焰；或@Check[survival|dc:15]检定以闷灭火焰。
Spreading Fire.hazarddescription: 火焰吞没一个5尺×5尺的区域，然后在它每次自己的回合都会扩散。
Spreading Fire.routine: （1动作）在它的回合，火势会扩散到额外若干方格中，其数量等于当前火焰占据格数的一半，至少为1格。由你决定火势扩散到哪些方格——通常是那些可燃材料最多的格子。任何在火焰旁结束其回合的生物受到@Damage[1d6[fire]]伤害，而任何位于火焰之中的生物受到@Damage[4d6[fire]]伤害。两者均为@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]豁免。一个生物每轮只能因火焰受到一次伤害。

Spreading Flames.name: 蔓延火焰 Spreading Flames
Spreading Flames.description:
触发 一个生物进入印刷屋

效果 空气涌入使火势猛涨，造成@Damage[1d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]豁免）。随后火焰骰先攻。

Besunas.name: 贝苏纳斯 Besunas
Besunas.publicNotes: Wherever learning and instruction is called for within the burning shadows of Hell, from the bureaus of Dis and coffers of Erebus to the war colleges of Malebolge and Caina's courtrooms, docent devils ply their unassuming and perspicacious trade. The instillo, so named for their creativity and talent in instilling a respect for Hell's ways and legitimacy to captive audiences, are valued for their ability to transform recently conquered lands into compliant, even loyal, client-states. The conquered are taught to be ashamed of their origins; the despairing are issued philosophies that displace blame and uncertainty upon the mistakes of history and geography; the orphaned are taught to respect those who orphaned them.
Besunas.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Correcting Veil.name: Correcting Veil
Correcting Veil.description: 100 feet. The instillo's telepathic presence constantly monitors perspectives and molds thought toward an infernal clarity. Creatures within the aura gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat but are unaware of this effect. The instillo is instantly aware when any creature within the aura fails a Recall Knowledge check and influences the erroneous information that the creature gains.

Nod of the Tongue.name: Nod of the Tongue
Nod of the Tongue.description: Creatures who can understand Diabolic take a –2 status penalty to their Will saves against the instillo's effects with the auditory or mental trait.

Quiet Confidence.name: Quiet Confidence
Quiet Confidence.description: The instillo can hide the source of their magic. If the next action the instillo uses is to Cast a Spell, that spell gains the subtle trait. The trait hides only the spell's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects.

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description: The instillo's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Superlative Rhetoric.name: Superlative Rhetoric
Superlative Rhetoric.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The instillo's most recent action was to cast a spell with the auditory trait

Effect The instillo immediately casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{Daze} at a creature that can hear them.

Drude.name: 萦惧影狐 Drude
Drude.publicNotes:
萦惧影狐是一种夜餮精，是夜晚萦绕着恐惧之地的化身。这种宛如阴影、懂得变形的精类会被发生过巨大悲剧、失却和冲突之地所吸引，然后在这种场所捕食受害者对周遭环境的恐惧。萦惧影狐会怀揣着反常的愉悦来玩弄猎物，在夜间恐吓对方直至将其逼得精疲力竭。它们怀有恶意但并非真正的邪恶，萦惧影狐通常不会致人死亡，因为这么做会终结它们的乐趣。在面对无法取胜的局面时，这种精类更倾向于逃跑而非战斗。

萦惧影狐的真实形态看起来像是一只消瘦且没有尾巴的狐狸，通体由黑暗和宛如幽魂般的阴影所构成，不过萦惧影狐很少向其他人展露真容。当萦惧影狐锁定目标后，会更倾向于变成适合潜入到受害者入睡之处的形态，比如流浪狗、附近的灌木丛或者目标随身装备中的某件物品。

若萦惧影狐找不到合适的游玩场所，就会亲自打造一个。它们会先找到一处最偏僻的地点，然后上演一场精彩的表演，用以激发当地居民的恐惧。在被萦惧影狐选中的领地中生活的不幸居民会被怪异的人影尾随、被凄厉的哀鸣所侵扰、被可怖的梦魇萦绕——这一切都是变形的萦惧影狐为自己营造完美环境所使用的把戏。在极其罕见的情况下，萦惧影狐可能会缠上某个特定的受害者，尾随他前往别处，选择萦绕在此人身边而非某个地点。

Lay Bare.name: 现原形 Lay Bare
Lay Bare.description: 使用变身的萦惧影狐在生命值降低到一半以下时，就会恢复到其真实形态下。

Nightmare Herald.name: 梦魇先驱 Nightmare Herald
Nightmare Herald.description: 90尺。在萦惧影狐的灵光内睡眠的生物会被可怖梦魇所折磨，必须尝试@Check[will|dc:18]豁免。失败时，会在醒来时陷入持续24小时的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 1}。大失败时还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]。

Change Shape.name: 变身 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
萦惧影狐呈现出小型动物或者无生命物体的形态。这不会影响它的数据，但是在动物形态下，这可能会改变其打击所造成的伤害类型。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Haunting Echoes.name: 萦绕回响 Haunting Echoes
Haunting Echoes.description:
萦惧影狐以30尺内它能看到的一个生物为目标，用幻觉鬼影和夜间的恐怖氛围袭击它。该生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:18]豁免。

大成功 该生物不会受到影响并且获得24小时的临时免疫。

成功 该生物承受@Damage[1d6[mental]]伤害。

失败 该生物承受@Damage[1d6[mental]]伤害并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

大失败 该生物承受@Damage[2d6[mental]]伤害并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。

Gala Crowd.name: 宴会人群 Gala Crowd
Gala Crowd.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:19]、@Check[diplomacy|dc:21]或@Check[athletics|dc:24]，以让宾客移出危险区域；在所有技能上累计获得4次成功才能解除该危害。
Gala Crowd.hazarddescription: 陷入恐慌的宴会来宾人群对这次意外袭击做出反应。
Gala Crowd.routine:
（1动作）人群会以下列方式之一反应，由d12掷骰决定：

  • 1–2 蹲伏：人群因恐惧而僵住。它为大厅内的所有生物提供次等掩蔽，持续1轮。
  • 3–4 跑！：确定一个随机方向。区域内每名生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:21]豁免，否则被向该方向移动10尺。大失败时，他们还会被击倒@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。这是强迫移动。
  • 5–6 歇斯底里：人群的恐惧会传染。区域内每名生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:21]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}）。这是情绪、恐惧与心灵特征效果。
  • 7–8 哀号：哭喊声让人难以专注。持续1轮，区域内任何尝试带有专注特征的动作的生物，必须成功通过@Check[flat|dc:4]，否则该动作被打断。这是听觉特征效果。
  • 9–10 挤压：人群成员推搡挤压，试图找到逃生之路。区域内每名生物受到@Damage[(2d8+5)[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic]豁免）。

  • 11–12 狂乱：混乱令人失控。区域内每名生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:21]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}，持续1轮。这是情绪与心灵特征效果。

Panic at the Gala.name: 宴会上的恐慌 Panic at the Gala
Panic at the Gala.description:
触发 一名生物骰先攻

效果 人群发生踩踏，对所有在大厅地面上的生物造成@Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]豁免），然后该危害骰先攻。

Skirmancer Mage.name: 退伍兵法师 Skirmancer Mage
Skirmancer Mage.publicNotes:
A watchmage uses a mix of magic and martial training to enforce the law. They magically detect invisible criminals, locate stolen property, and counter illegal spells.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

Arcane Watch.name: Arcane Watch
Arcane Watch.description: The watchmage can either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} while using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detect Magic} exploration activity.

Counter Escape.name: Counter Escape
Counter Escape.description:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell with the teleportation trait or as a reaction

Effect The watchmage expends a spell slot of the same rank or higher as the trigger creature's spell and attempts to counteract the triggering spell (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+11 #Counteract]]{+11}).

Eldritch Arms.name: Eldritch Arms
Eldritch Arms.description: In a brief ritual that takes 10 minutes, the watchmage chooses a single weapon or unarmed attack through which they can focus their magic. Strikes the watchmage makes with that weapon are magical and deal 1d6 additional force damage.

Spellbound Strike.name: Spellbound Strike
Spellbound Strike.description:
Requirements The watchmage is wielding the weapon chosen with Eldritch Arms

Effect The watchmage Casts a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast, imbuing that spell into the weapon. The watchmage Strikes with the required weapon. This counts as two attacks for the watchmage's multiple attack penalty. On a hit, the target is also affected by the spell, though the target gets any normal defenses allowed by the spell.

If the spell is targeted, it targets the creature that was hit and no one else. If the spell is an area, the target must be in the area. A burst is centered on a corner of the target's square if the target is Medium or smaller, or the corner of a square closest to the creature's center if it's Large or larger. A cone or line emits from a square of the watchmage's choice adjacent to the target.

Redcap.name: 红帽精 Redcap
Redcap.publicNotes:
Redcaps are sadistic and capricious fey who thrill in bloodletting and murder. While they are most famous for appearing as wizened, bearded men, redcaps of other genders are no less fearsome or cruel. However, redcaps are ultimately craven bullies, cowed by anything more powerful than themselves, a trait that leads them to fear and despise the symbols of deities.

Many fairy tales explain how the redcaps draw power from dipping the hats for which they are named in fresh blood. Just as iconic to these cruel little fey are their iron-clad boots, and the clanging sound of their metal soles clanking on stone floors is both discordant and disconcerting—especially to those who recognize the sound for what it is. Redcaps typically stand only 3 feet tall, with hunched frames, pointed ears, crooked teeth, and long, white, tangled hair.

Though unlikely to share true affection, redcaps find camaraderie in murder. Small troupes of redcaps travel together, sharing bloody kills and reminiscing on their brutal exploits. They loathe the company of most other creatures, with the notable exception of the feline fey called elananxes.

Red Cap.name: Red Cap
Red Cap.description:
A redcap's woolen hat is dyed with the blood of their victims. If the redcap loses their cap, they no longer benefit from fast healing and take a –4 status penalty to their damage rolls. They can create a new cap in 10 minutes, but that cap doesn't grant them powers until the redcap has turned it red with Blood Soak. A cap has no benefit for creatures other than the redcap who made it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.s5mS7CyE0oOYlecv]{Effect: Lost Red Cap}

Divine Revulsion.name: Divine Revulsion
Divine Revulsion.description:
If a redcap sees a creature brandish a religious symbol of a deity (which requires an Interact action by that creature) or cast a divine spell while wearing a religious symbol, the redcap must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19] save. They then become temporarily immune to all brandished religious symbols for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The redcap is unaffected.

Success The redcap is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Failure The redcap gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition for 1 round and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

Blood Soak.name: Blood Soak
Blood Soak.description:
The redcap dips their cap in the blood of a slain foe. The foe must have died in the last minute, and the redcap must have helped kill it. The redcap gains a +4 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wPIGBcpCqCWgrCiq]{Effect: Blood Soak}

Deadly Cleave.name: Deadly Cleave
Deadly Cleave.description:
Trigger The redcap reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a halberd Strike

Effect The redcap makes another halberd Strike against a different creature, using the same multiple attack penalty as the halberd Strike that triggered this reaction. This counts toward their multiple attack penalty as normal.

Red Drip.name: 红滴 Red Drip
Red Drip.description:
每当红帽精成功以打击命中一个生物，该生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免，以对抗这种会缓慢侵蚀肢体、使人衰弱的真菌感染。

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

阶段1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}（1天）

阶段2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2}，且使用受感染肢体会造成@Damage[3d6[persistent,bleed]]伤害（1天）

阶段3 笨拙2、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，且受感染肢体无法使用（1天）

阶段4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 3}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 3}，且受感染肢体永久无法使用（1天）

阶段5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}，且伤害不会结束困惑状态（1天）

阶段6 死亡

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description: The redcap Strides up to half its Speed and makes a boot Strike at any point during that movement. If the boot Strike hits a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} creature, it deals an extra @Damage[2d6[bleed]].

Hellknight Field-Maralictor.name: 地狱骑士战地执棒士 Hellknight Field-Maralictor
Hellknight Field-Maralictor.publicNotes:
Elite fighters from the lowest ranks of nobility, knights are proud champions of their court. Unlike other nobles, knights must earn their title through loyalty and strength-of-arms rather than inheritance. Ideals such as chivalry, honor, and virtue are associated with knights but not all meet such romantic standards.

The denizens of a noble court are the most powerful people in a civilization, primed with wealth, station, and authority above the common people.

Hellknight's Rigor.name: 地狱骑士的坚毅 Hellknight's Rigor
Hellknight's Rigor.description: 每当地狱骑士战地执棒士获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧}状态时，他都能将其数值降低1点。

Quick Shield Block.name: 快速盾牌格挡 Quick Shield Block
Quick Shield Block.description:
地狱骑士战地执棒士获得一个额外的反应动作，该反应动作只能用于盾牌格挡。

他们可以为一名相邻盟友使用盾牌格挡，使该盟友免于受到伤害，而非保护他们自己。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ShieldBlock]

Intimidating Strike.name: 威慑打击 Intimidating Strike
Intimidating Strike.description: 地狱骑士战地执棒士进行一次近战打击。若该打击命中并造成伤害，则目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}；若为重击，则目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

Maralictor's Command.name: 副执棒士号令 Maralictor's Command
Maralictor's Command.description: 地狱骑士战地执棒士对其选择的一名盟友下达命令。该盟友可以花费一个反应动作来行走并打击。该盟友对副执棒士号令免疫24小时。

Warding Shift.name: 换防 Warding Shift
Warding Shift.description:
需求 地狱骑士战地执棒士与一名自愿盟友相邻

效果 地狱骑士战地执棒士将一名相邻的自愿盟友向任意方向移动5尺，并可以快步进入该盟友让出的空间。
